Standing policy

“You can always file yourself for free — we’ll tell you that upfront, before you sign anything.”

ClaimWerks is here for people who’d rather have the paperwork, filing, and follow-through handled for them.

What it costs

Nothing upfront. Nothing if we don't recover.

ClaimWerks works on contingency. Our fee comes out of what we recover — never out of your pocket.
